Abandonment of Roads Not in Primary or Secondary State Highway System

law.catch_line: County roads not part of primary or secondary state highway system; definitions

text.section: The provisions of this article shall apply mutatis mutandis to county roads maintained by a county and not part of the secondary state highway system and to roads dedicated to public use but that are not part of the primary or secondary state highway system.

For the purposes of this article: "Governing body" means the governing body of a county. "Road" includes streets and alleys dedicated to public use and any existing crossing by the lines of a railroad company of such road and a railroad crossing by such road of the lines of a railroad company.
